query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Stripe on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Stripe Briefing: 16 October to 15 November 2026

Prepared for the meeting on 17 November 2026. Only items dated within the window and linkable to a source are included.

## News

- **Global Payouts reaches $1 billion in vendor payments (30 October 2026).** Stripe reports that Global Payouts has paid over $1 billion to more than 3,400 US and UK vendors. New-market setup time fell from up to six weeks to one. Stripe also raised the ACH and wire limits on its Outbound Payments API to $100 million [3].
- **Press coverage.** No in-window press coverage from a reputable outlet with a linkable URL was verified. Coverage of the Parafin acquisition (agreed 30 September) and the PayPal/Advent matter (last reported August 2026) falls outside the window.

## Product Launches

- **Introducing Stripe Treasury for agents (21 October 2026).** Stripe announced this product for AI agents, as shown in its newsroom listing [1].
- **API version 2026-10-28.endive (28 October 2026, general availability).** The release adds:
  - Open USD (OUSD) as a supported crypto token.
  - Scalapay Payment Links support, and SeQura for invoices and subscriptions.
  - Subscription pausing in the customer portal.
  - Outbound payments APIs (Payout Intents, Outbound Payments, Recipient Verifications), plus Financial Addresses v2.
  - Support for the Stripe Terminal T600 reader.
  - Tax registrations for Botswana, Ghana, Ivory Coast and Mauritius [2].
- **Public previews (28 October 2026).** Wero bank redirect for the EU, multi-currency settlement for connected accounts, and the Queries and Reports API, which lets users query Stripe data with SQL [2].

## Executive and Team Hires

- No in-window executive appointment, departure or promotion was found with a linkable source. The Stripe newsroom listing contains no personnel announcements in the window.
- A Microsoft proxy filing dated 21 October 2026 nominates Stripe co-founder and President John Collison to Microsoft's board. This is an outside board role, and no linkable primary source was captured, so it is excluded.

## Deals and Partnerships

- **HSBC UK Tap to Pay (10 November 2026).** Stripe and HSBC announced Tap to Pay for UK small businesses [1].
- **Samsung Wallet stablecoin purchases (5 November 2026).** Stripe announced stablecoin purchases in Samsung Wallet [1].
- **Anthropic (21 October 2026).** Stripe and Anthropic announced a partnership to help entrepreneurs run their business inside Claude [1].
- **Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team (20 October 2026).** Stripe announced a partnership with the team [1].

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. Outbound Payments limits for ACH and wires were raised to $100 million. What risk controls and monitoring apply to these flows, and do they change for new markets? [2][3]
2. OUSD is now a supported token, and stablecoin purchases are live in Samsung Wallet. How does Stripe balance stablecoin growth with compliance and consumer protection requirements? [1][2]
3. Treasury for agents and agent-driven purchases are now live. How does Stripe govern agent-initiated payments, including spending limits, approvals and dispute handling? [1]

### Sources

[1] Stripe Newsroom: https://stripe.com/newsroom/news
[2] Stripe API Changelog, Endive (2026-09-30 and 2026-10-28 releases): https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive
[3] Stripe on Stripe: What we learned moving $1B in vendor payments to Global Payouts (Stripe Blog, 30 October 2026): https://stripe.com/blog/stripe-on-stripe-what-we-learned-moving-1b-in-vendor-payments-to-global-payouts
